title: Good app
body: Nice app, simple yet effective. However, fails could be distinguished from successes by colour (e.g. fail - red, success - green, streak - a green line). This could all be customisable. Also, there’s no option to give the habit a duration or end date which is bad :( will give 5 stars if you deploy these suggestions
